name: MeOPP
summary: para-Methoxyphenylpiperazine (pMeOPP), also known as 4-methoxyphenylpiperazine (4-MeOPP), is a substituted piperazine derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as an ingredient in "Party pills", initially in New Zealand and subsequently in other countries around the world.

pharmacology.text: para-Methoxyphenylpiperazine (pMeOPP), also known as 4-methoxyphenylpiperazine (4-MeOPP), is a substituted piperazine derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as an ingredient in "Party pills", initially in New Zealand and subsequently in other countries around the world.

body.says: The human liver P450 CYP2D6 converts para-methoxyphenylpiperazine by demethylation to para-hydroxyphenylpiperazine.

uses.text: para-Methoxyphenylpiperazine (pMeOPP), also known as 4-methoxyphenylpiperazine (4-MeOPP), is a substituted piperazine derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as an ingredient in "Party pills", initially in New Zealand and subsequently in other countries around the world.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Related party-pill piperazines such as BZP can cause anxiety, headache, nausea, a racing heart, sleeplessness and, in some cases, seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。BZP 等相關的派對藥丸哌嗪類可能引起焦慮、頭痛、噁心、心跳過快、失眠，有時還會引發癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。BZP 等相关的派对药丸哌嗪类可能引起焦虑、头痛、恶心、心跳过快、失眠，有时还会引发癫痫。

fact.en: MeOPP was one of the piperazines sold in New Zealand's legal party pills, alongside BZP and TFMPP.
fact.zh: MeOPP 是紐西蘭合法「派對藥丸」中販售的哌嗪類之一，與 BZP、TFMPP 並列。
fact.zhHans: MeOPP 是新西兰合法「派对药丸」中贩售的哌嗪类之一，与 BZP、TFMPP 并列。
